passages.provision_quote: An employer shall provide a written notice that an ADS, for the purpose of making employment-related decisions, not including hiring, is in use at the workplace to a worker who will foreseeably be directly affected by the ADS, or their authorized representative
passages.note: Notice and use-restriction duties fall on the employer deploying the ADS, not on AI developers, and the bill requires no pre-use safety testing of the AI system itself.

rows.reasoning: SB 7, authored by Senator McNerney, requires employers to notify workers of ADS use and restricts how employers may rely on an ADS for discipline, termination, or deactivation decisions, but it does not hold AI developers legally responsible for harm their systems cause (rung 3's clause: 'legal responsibility... on the developer or company') and it imposes no pre-use safety testing of the AI system (rung 4's clause: 'require safety testing before AI can be used'). Per the annex, duties placed on the employer as user of the ADS rather than on its developer are oversight, not developer liability or testing, so the bill shows direction only.
